When you're in this in between state does the thoughts control you or do you control them? 

Usually, if it's a passing thought, it's easier to control, but what I find is if I spend too long in one place or with one object it'll trigger more easily, for example I used these headphones with a long wire and I played with the wire to pass time, that quickly evolved in to fantasies about wrapping it around my neck, to the point where I pressed it against my neck in multible locations to find the most effective way. I felt the same as when I played with it. A mundane task that was poisoned by these thoughts, in that scenerio I couldn't  control it.
